issues: Does not calculate or filter daytime temperatures; it plots all rows regardless of hour.
Does not aggregate intraday readings into daily daytime temperatures despite the requested daily temperature plot.
Silently ignores timezone conversion/localization errors, which can hide malformed input instead of raising ValueError.
Does not validate that the temperature column is numeric.
Mutates global matplotlib rcParams, which can leak Arial font settings into unrelated plots.
